preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of words.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[1:]) == n and all(len(word) > 0 for word in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n non-empty words separated by single spaces, where each word consists of uppercase/lowercase letters and digits.
The total length of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([stdin.split()[0]] + [stdin.split()[i] for i in range(1, n)]) if n == 1 else stdout == ''.join(merge_words(stdin.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If n == 1, stdout is the single word. Otherwise, stdout is the result of merging words left-to-right, where merging two words removes the longest prefix of the second word that matches a suffix of the first word.
